**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Crimean Bridge explosion|Crimean Bridge explosion]]
****The [[Kerch Strait Bridge]] is hit by an [[explosion]], resulting in a fire and the partial collapse of a road section. Three people are killed. The cause is currently unknown, with a [[Russia]]n investigative committee saying it was a Ukrainian [[truck bomb]]. **Two 17-year-old [[Palestinians]] are killed and 11 more injured during a raid when three gunmen [[mass shooting|open fire]] in a [[mass shooting]] at a refugee camp in [[Jenin]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Argentina]]
**The Ministry of Economy of [[Argentina]] announces regulations on import authorizations in an attempt to prevent fraud and preserve the country's reserves of [[U.S. dollar]]s, according to the [[Central Bank of Argentina|Central Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/argentina-tighten-import-controls-preserve-dollars-sources-2022-10-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 12 people are killed and 30 others are injured when a bus collides with a [[Tank truck|diesel tanker]] and catches fire in [[Nashik]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/least-12-dead-over-30-injured-bus-fire-indias-nashik-city-2022-10-08 (Reuters)]
*At least 76 people are killed after a boat carrying people fleeing floodwater [[Capsizing|capsizes]] in [[Anambra State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-63194379 (BBC)]
*Four people are killed by [[flash floods]] across [[Cambodia]]. Thousands of [[hectare]]s of crops are inundated. [https://english.news.cn/20221008/250e30b9d3674cbea1d45c60c41f5118/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Law and crime'''
*All rail traffic in northern [[Germany]] is suspended for nearly three hours in the morning after [[October 2022 german railway attack|vital cables for the rail were found cut]]. [[Deutsche Bahn]] blames [[sabotage]] for the incident and [[Federal Police (Germany)|Federal Police]] launch an investigation into the incident.
